verdict.rationale: Diff inspection is well documented. Agent edits get full inline diffs with accept/reject/undo, and a dedicated Diff Review page offers a per-file list and side-by-side view. Running checks is only implied: the agent has shell access to run scripts and package managers, and the GitHub plugin mentions pull requests and actions, but no dedicated test, lint, or CI check workflow before merging is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-merge check/test runner integrated with diff review, a documented merge-gating workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff review.
